title: L-space Conjecture
exact_target: Are three descriptions of a rational homology three-sphere equivalent: nonminimal Floer homology, an orderable nontrivial fundamental group, and a coorientable taut foliation?

sources.citation: J. Hanselman, "L-spaces, foliations, and left-orderability," Princeton RTG lecture, notes by J. Van Dyke; conjecture due to Boyer-Gordon-Watson (Math. Ann. 356 (2013)) and Juhasz.
